annotations.title: Does Genko Prior Auth fit this practice?

description: Say whether Genko Prior Auth supports a practice's specialty (own form, general form, or not supported) and what it offers there, from what the product implements. A payer can be given, but the product does not evaluate payers or payer rules, and the answer says so.

payer.description: Optional payer name. The product does not evaluate payers; the answer says so.

specialty.description: The practice's specialty in plain words, e.g. 'dental', 'physical therapy', 'aesthetics', 'optometry'.

name: check_fit

fit.description: dedicated = own code lists and findings form; generic_form = general form; not_supported = no
